description:
The Asian School of the Environment (ASE) at Nanyang Technological University (NTU) is an interdisciplinary school focusing on the connections between geosciences, ecology, society and Earth systems. Our approach integrates these disciplines to examine big hazards and environmental challenges both in Southeast Asia and globally. We conduct cutting-edge research on topics that include geohazards, climate change, sea-level rise, environmental sustainability, conservation of environment and biodiversity, and interactions between environment and society.

  

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/ase .

  

We are seeking a motivated and organised Research Fellow to support research activities, coordinate collaborative projects, and laboratory operations. The successful candidate will conduct research while playing a central role in project planning, coordination across research teams and collaborators, and the development of future research directions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Conduct research aligned with the group’s research programmes, contributing to study design, data analysis, and scientific publications.
* Coordinate research projects, monitor progress against milestones, and support the timely delivery of project outcomes.
* Facilitate collaboration across projects, research teams, and external partners through regular communication, meetings, and follow-up activities.
* Manage day-to-day laboratory operations, including procurement, inventory, equipment maintenance, and compliance with institutional safety requirements.
* Coordinate project logistics, including sample collection and transport, permits, and research-related travel.
* Support the preparation of research reports, presentations, grant proposals, and other project documentation.
* Contribute to future research planning by identifying priorities, developing project plans, and exploring funding and collaboration opportunities.
Support and mentor students and research staff in research activities and laboratory practices.  

  

**Job Requirements:**

  

* A PhD in genetics, environmental science, biological sciences, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated research experience and the ability to contribute independently to scientific projects and publications.
* Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience in laboratory operations and research logistics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse collaborators.
A proactive and collaborative approach, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.  

  

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

**Title:** Sustainability Data Analyst Intern

**Location:** Singapore

Join a **growing and global team** focused on **measuring climate risks** and bringing new data and rating services to investors. As climate **physical and transition risks** increasingly impact investors’ portfolios and corporate balance sheets, the need for **high-quality climate risk data and assessment tools** is rising.

EDHEC Climate Institute is looking for a **Sustainability Data Analyst Intern** to support our team in **collecting, processing, and analysing sustainability-related data** for infrastructure assets. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in data extraction, carbon emissions analysis, and geospatial analysis.

Beyond core data processing tasks, the internship can be tailored to the candidate’s interests and expertise. This could include **research projects and case studies** on climate risk assessment and financial materiality analysis, allowing you to contribute meaningfully while expanding your expertise.

**Duration:** 3 to 6 months

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Data Collection & Cleaning:** Verify, clean, and structure sustainability- and climate-related data from reports and other sources.
* **Data Quality & Accuracy Checks:** Conduct detailed data validation and consistency checks to ensure high data quality across datasets.
* **Accuracy Verification:** Ensure the precision of extracted data, including asset attributes and boundaries.
* **Geospatial Analysis:** Use tools such as QGIS or ArcGIS to extract, review, and analyse asset boundaries and spatial data.
* **Knowledge Management & Documentation:** Support the setup and maintenance of team documentation, including Notion workspaces, internal wikis, and process guides to improve data workflows and knowledge sharing.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for candidates who:

* Have a strong interest in sustainability, climate risks, and environmental data.
* Have some experience and/or a strong interest in climate-related research or data work.
* Are highly detail-oriented, with a strong eye for identifying data inconsistencies and errors.
* Are organised and methodical, with an interest in improving processes and documentation.

· At least a bachelor’s degree in a technical curriculum such as computer science, finance, economics, or physics

* Can work independently, take ownership of tasks, and are eager to learn new skills.
* Preferably have basic proficiency in Python for data processing or analysis.
* **Preferably** have prior exposure to geospatial data and tools such as QGIS or ArcGIS.
* **Preferably** have experience setting up or maintaining documentation tools (e.g. Notion, Confluence, or internal wikis).

**What You’ll Gain**

* Practical experience in sustainability data analysis and climate risk research.
* Hands-on exposure to geospatial analysis and real-world asset data.
* Experience working with data quality assurance and internal knowledge systems.
* A flexible internship experience tailored to your skills, interests, and performance.
* The opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a mission-driven and growing team.

**Interested?** Apply now by sending your resume (pdf format) and a brief statement of interest.

*Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 21 days, please assume your application has not been successful on this occasion.*

Scientific Climate Ratings brings climate risk data and ratings to investors. =========================

* A strong interest in sustainability, climate risk and infrastructure
* Close attention to detail and accuracy when handling data
* Comfort reading and extracting information from annual and sustainability reports
* Ability to work independently and eagerness to learn new skills

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Basic Python for data processing and analysis
* Experience with geospatial data and tools such as QGIS or ArcGIS

**What you'll gain**
====================

* Practical experience in sustainability data analysis and climate risk research
* Hands-on exposure to geospatial analysis and carbon emissions modelling
* The chance to contribute to a new climate ratings business backed by EDHEC's research expertise

**How to apply**
================

Send your CV and a short statement of interest in pdf format with the subject line "Sustainability Data Analyst Intern – [Your Name]".

  
  

**About us**
============

Scientific Climate Ratings is an EDHEC Business School venture that brings EDHEC's research-driven data and ratings on climate risk to investors. description:
**Job Title:** **Postdoctoral Fellow in Urban and Regional Climate Modeling**
=============================================================================

University-Level Unit: Arts & Social Sciences

Faculty/Department-Level Unit: Geography

Employee Category: Research Staff

Location\\_ONB: Kent Ridge Campus

Posting Start Date: 18/11/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------

Climate change, from local to regional to global scale, coupled with rapid urban development, is reshaping interactions between climatic processes, cities, and people. This position seeks a researcher to advance fundamental and applied research in urban climate, hydroclimate and regional climate modeling, heat-health impacts, or energy. Depending on the candidate’s expertise, research may examine how cities modify climatic forcing and multi-scale environmental conditions, as well as how climatic forcing affects urban systems, including hydroclimatic extremes, human exposure and health outcomes, and energy demand. The successful candidate will utilize numerical modeling (e.g., WRF or similar), observations, geospatial data, data-driven, and/or AI/ML approaches to better understand these interactions and their consequences across spatial and temporal scales.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Responsibilities**  
This position requires strong quantitative analysis and modeling skills centered on conducting and analyzing output from numerical modeling simulations. Key requirements include:
  

* A PhD degree in Geography, Atmospheric Science or Meteorology, Engineering, or a related field
* Excellent programming skills (e.g., Fortran 90/95, Python, Bash/shell scripting) and demonstrated ability to develop efficient computational workflows
* Demonstrated experience with high-performance computing
* Demonstrated experience configuring, executing, and analyzing global or regional climate models (e.g., WRF or comparable modeling system)
* Demonstrated experience managing, processing, analyzing, and visualizing large and complex datasets, including numerical model output
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Demonstrated experience publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals

  

**About the institute**

The QS World University rankings place NUS in the top 15 universities in the world and number one in Asia. In the same rankings the Department of Geography is generally ranked among the top 10 Geography programmes globally. Further information on the Department is available at: http://www.fas.nus.edu.sg/geog

This position is available for one year, renewable for a second year contingent upon satisfactory performance. Salary will be commensurate with experience, and it will be aligned with the NUS salary scale. An annual bonus, dependent on performance, is also potentially available, in-line with NUS policy.

  

**Hiring Procedures**

Further enquiries can be directed to Prof Matei GEORGESCU. More information can be found at: https://discovery.nus.edu.sg/31796-matei-georgescu

Deadline for all application: 15 December 2026
